name: h264-ac3.mkv
notes: Playable video, unsupported audio: expect a silent picture in the browser.
Matroska (MKV) playback support varies: Chrome/Edge demux it, Safari and Firefox generally do not.
Dolby Digital (AC3/E-AC3) audio: browsers cannot decode it — you will get video with no sound. Use VLC/mpv, or open the stream URL there.
